question: Analyze the soccer match dataset to determine the champion team for each season across all countries and leagues, awarding 3 points for every win, 1 point for every tie, and 0 points for every loss. For each season, return the champion’s team name, the league, the country, and the total points accumulated.
sql:
WITH team_points AS (
    SELECT m.season, 
           l.name as league, 
           c.name as country,
           t.team_long_name,
           SUM(
             CASE 
               WHEN m.home_team_api_id = t.team_api_id AND m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal THEN 3
               WHEN m.home_team_api_id = t.team_api_id AND m.home_team_goal = m.away_team_goal THEN 1
               WHEN m.away_team_api_id = t.team_api_id AND m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal THEN 3
               WHEN m.away_team_api_id = t.team_api_id AND m.home_team_goal = m.away_team_goal THEN 1
               ELSE 0
             END
           ) as total_points
    FROM Match m
    JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
    JOIN Country c ON l.country_id = c.id
    JOIN Team t ON t.team_api_id IN (m.home_team_api_id, m.away_team_api_id)
    GROUP BY m.season, l.name, c.name, t.team_long_name
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT season, league, country, team_long_name, 
           CAST(total_points AS INTEGER) as total_points,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY season, league ORDER BY total_points DESC) as rn
    FROM team_points
)
SELECT season, league, country, team_long_name, total_points
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY season, country, league
